action_gating.purpose: prevent arithmetic-only outputs 10..18 from being punished by pre-addition tasks

learner.scientific_constraint: No numeric magnitude or arithmetic result is supplied. Internal plasticity receives only a scalar reward after the learner chooses an action plus credit derived from its own state/readout weights.

scientific_scope: Stage 3S.1 keeps arbitrary symbol codes and no numeric magnitude features. Identity/successor use a 0..9 action mask so arithmetic-only outputs 10..18 are not negatively trained before addition. A shared token projection and recurrent sparse state are reward-gated plastic. The target is used only after choice to issue scalar reward. Frozen tests still separate seen, reversed, and completely held-out addition pairs. FlyWire coordinates remain visualization-only, not simulated connectome spikes.
